bagPolicy.summary: Permitted bags are clear plastic, vinyl, or PVC up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, or clutches/camera/binocular cases up to 4.5 x 6.5 inches.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
prohibited: Non-clear bags over the size limit
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
